_label: SYNTHETIC — sanitised response captured from the live app during the v1 behaviour audit

data.connectionNote: Hi, I'm a Lead Data Analyst in Utrecht. I built a dbt + Snowflake semantic layer (42 metrics) and ran 14 A/B tests. Larkspur's churn and fleet-utilisation work caught my eye. Open to a 15-minute chat on how you model subscription data?
data.inMailSubject: Modelling churn and fleet utilisation in dbt on Snowflake
data.inMailBody:
Hi, Larkspur owning both churn and fleet utilisation across 6 cities means the subscription models have to hold up under pricing tests and monthly leadership reviews. That is a hard modelling problem.

At Quokka Logistics I built a dbt + Snowflake semantic layer covering 42 core metrics, backed by 190 dbt tests. It cut weekly reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. Earlier, at Fjordline Retail, I ran 14 A/B tests and wrote the test-design checklist the company still uses.

Would you be open to a 15-minute chat on how you structure subscription data in dbt so pricing experiments stay trustworthy? Happy to share what worked for us on metric definitions and testing.

Mira
tips: Primary target: the Hiring Manager for the Data Platform team. They own the modelling layer and can judge the dbt and Snowflake proof directly. One flag: your brief names Brightquill Labs, but the JD is for Larkspur Mobility. Confirm the hiring manager's company before sending, and swap the company name in the hook if needed.

Alternate 1: a Senior Analytics Engineer or Data Engineer on the same team. A peer can speak candidly about how the team works with dbt and Snowflake, and may refer you internally. Lead with the 190 dbt tests and 42-metric semantic layer.

Alternate 2: the Recruiter or Talent Partner for the role. Use this if you cannot find or reach the hiring manager. Shorten the message to the role fit: dbt, Snowflake, 14 A/B tests, Power BI and Looker.

Fit check before you send: this JD is analyst-heavy (dashboards, A/B tests, monthly leadership readouts) and your target is Analytics Engineer with ownership of the modelling layer. The dbt on Snowflake work is the overlap. Salary EUR 70-80k sits below your EUR 85k target, so raise comp early or skip if the modelling scope is small.
The message names the dbt modelling angle on purpose. It signals you want the analytics-engineering part of the role, not just dashboards.
The connection note is under 300 characters. Check the count after you edit the company name.
Phone numbers are left out. Add a calendar link only if you are comfortable sharing one.
